run_closest_inter_dataset_clusters: run the script to find closest inter-dataset clusters across CelebA, ImageNet, and Places205 using SAE representations
build_get_sender: build a frozen POP sender agent from a checkpoint path using dummy options and a VGG11 vision model
run_get_distances: run get_distances to compute cross-entropy distances between SAE representations and one-hot vectors for a dataset
review_get_sender: review the get_sender function that constructs a POP game with hardcoded dummy options and returns the sender
